questions.question: If g(x) = f(x - 1) + 2, how is the graph of f transformed to obtain g?
options: Shifted left 1 units and up 2 units
Shifted right 1 units and down 2 units
Reflected across the x-axis
Shifted right 1 units and up 2 units
questions.explanation: D is correct. Replacing x by x-h shifts right, and adding k shifts up.
questions.teachingTopic: 函数平移、伸缩、反射与参数影响

questions.question: If g(x) = -f(x) + 2, how is the graph of f transformed to obtain g?
options: Reflected across the x-axis and shifted up 2 units
Reflected across the y-axis and shifted up 2 units
Shifted down 2 units without a reflection
Vertically stretched by a factor of 2
questions.explanation: A is correct. Multiplying every output by -1 reflects the graph across the x-axis, and adding the constant shifts it upward.
questions.teachingTopic: 函数平移、伸缩、反射与参数影响

questions.question: If g(x) = 4f(x), how is the graph of f transformed to obtain g?
options: Horizontally stretched by a factor of 4
Vertically stretched by a factor of 4
Shifted right 4 units
Reflected across the y-axis
questions.explanation: B is correct. Multiplying the output scales all y-values by the factor.
questions.teachingTopic: 函数平移、伸缩、反射与参数影响

questions.question: If g(x) = f(x + 4), how is the graph of f transformed to obtain g?
options: Shifted right 4 units
Shifted up 4 units
Shifted left 4 units
Vertically stretched by a factor of 4
questions.explanation: C is correct. Adding h inside the input shifts the graph left by h.
